sources.quote: BR-310 brackets from Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) may be packed 40 per layer
Approved blank source: Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B), single source.

findings.why: The proposed change moves BR-310 to Alluminio Bormida. The only BR-310 record names Chisone as the source. The Bormida approval on file is for BR-220 only. No controlled record covers SUP-B, BR-310, a receiving plant and a customer, so I can't read absence as 'not approved'. The customer of BR-310 is not in the documents. The proposal may also be a mix-up with the BR-220 shortage discussed in the meeting and the email. A person must confirm which part is meant and whether a release exists.
